notes: Pages do not state the teaching language(s) of the programme. Tuition: using the institution-wide 'Instellingscollegegeld 2026-2027: € 10.648' figure, which explicitly applies to applicants who do not qualify for the statutory fee (typical for non-EU students), but it is not programme-specific and is for 2026-2027. No application deadline for non-EU applicants is stated anywhere. The programme page states 'Havo, vwo of mbo 4' as the admission requirement and mentions a 21+-toelatingsonderzoek for applicants 21+ without the right diploma. The language_proficiency rule uses the page's generic statement about Staatsexamen NT2-II for Dutch-taught programmes; no programme-specific language test is stated.
